title: Cardinal Billing Account Standing Rule: Returned-Payment Rate on Late Fee Charges
content:
**Rule.** A returned-payment rate applies to the late fee charge of a Cardinal Billing Account and multiplies it: **1.50** when two or more payments on the account were returned in the last 12 whole months, **1.25** when exactly one was, and **1.00** when none was.

A window of the last 12 whole months holds every record posted less than 12 whole months before the charge date, counted on calendar months. A returned payment is a payment posted to the account and later returned unpaid by the bank or card issuer, as shown by the returned-payment entries on the account's billing history; each return counts once, by the date it was posted.

| Returned payments on the account in the last 12 whole months | Returned-payment rate |
|---|---|
| 0 | 1.00 |
| 1 | 1.25 |
| 2 | 1.50 |
| 3 or more | 1.50 |

**Hypothetical figures.** A charge figured at $10.00 on an account with one returned payment in the window is multiplied by 1.25. A return posted 13 whole months before the charge date is outside the window and is not counted.
